description: This is a shell script used for publishing Docker images for Playwright, including tagging, pushing, and managing manifests across different Ubuntu versions and architectures.

methods.name: tag_and_push
methods.description: Tags a Docker image and pushes it to a registry, then attaches an end-of-life manifest.

methods.name: attach_eol_manifest
methods.description: Attaches an end-of-life artifact to a Docker image using oras.

methods.name: install_oras_if_needed
methods.description: Downloads and installs 'oras' CLI tool if not already present.

methods.name: publish_docker_images_with_arch_suffix
methods.description: Builds Docker images for specified architecture and tags them accordingly.

methods.name: publish_docker_manifest
methods.description: Creates and pushes Docker image manifests for multi-arch support.
